description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeAllowedCurrencyAPI within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup methods, data providers, and test methods to verify the API's behavior, specifically focusing on fetching all allowed currencies for a pay grade and handling unimplemented create and delete functionalities.

classes.name: PayGradeAllowedCurrencyAPITest
